profile.headline: CSM, Senior Software Developer at State Farm ®
profile.summary:
-Over eleven years of development experience in rapidly growing agile environments with a consistent track record of coaching and building self organizing teams utilizing Extreme Programming and Scrum based techniques.
-Extensive success with architecting and utilizing continuous integration systems to support iterative development processes with frequent code deployments that are built around concepts of automated testing and rapid development. 
-Significant expertise in developing applications utilizing Java and J2EE technologies. Front-end development using JSP, JavaScript and AJAX using spring-mvc frameworks. Back-end development using JDBC, Hibernate, SQL and Oracle Stored Procedures.
